Check the precession-constant test on a synthetic record

Source: R/test_tuned.R
test_tuned_check.Rd

Builds synthetic records (five orbital terms, a 405 kyr cycle and AR(1) noise) with a known precession constant and prints the k recovered by test_tuned. A check that the chosen tbw resolves the terms.

Usage

test_tuned_check(
  k_true = c(20.7, 21, 21.2, 21.4),
  tbw = 2,
  noise = 1.5,
  seed = 1,
  len = 5500,
  ...
)

Arguments

k_true

Known precession constants of the synthetic records, in kyr (numeric vector); one record is built and tested for each value. Default=c(20.7, 21.0, 21.2, 21.4).

tbw

MTM time-bandwidth product passed to test_tuned (numeric, > 0); see tbw there. Default=2.

noise

Standard deviation multiplier of the AR(1) noise (coefficient 0.7) added to the orbital signal (numeric, >= 0); the orbital terms have amplitudes up to 1. Default=1.5.

seed

Seed of the random number generator (integer), reset before each synthetic record so that the phases and noise can be reproduced. Default=1.

len

Length of the synthetic records in kyr, sampled every 1 kyr (numeric, > 0). Default=5500.

...

Further arguments passed on to test_tuned (e.g. age_ma, k_search); tbw, n_surr = 2 and plot = FALSE are already set.

Value

Prints one line per k_true.
